title: Daily panel (data_collection/panel/{trading_day}/panel.parquet), one row (daily_panel.v1)
description: The data collector's daily panel product (plan amendment 1, foundation rule architecture.d/146, alpha-engine-config-I10791 / P-25). ONE long-form price panel per trading day, compiled ONCE from the ArcticDB `universe` library over a trailing window, so crucible v2's `data.daily` reads it instead of compiling its own from raw ArcticDB. This schema validates ONE ROW of the parquet after `df.to_dict('records')` with `trading_day` rendered as an ISO date; the persisted artifact is the parquet and the row shape is the contract. Columns, their ORDER, and their unit suffixes are crucible's `crucible/data/sources.py::PANEL_COLUMNS` exactly (crucible's own `panel.v1`): a consumer that swaps its source must not be able to see a different shape. Keyed (trading_day, ticker), unique, sorted by (trading_day, ticker); the panel carries rows for its own trading_day. Prices and volume are RAW (`_raw`), never adjusted or normalized, and never null: the upstream ArcticDB row contract (arctic_universe.schema.json) forbids a missing OHLCV value, and a zero-fill would be the well-formed-artifact-containing-nothing shape. The day-level facts (row/symbol/session counts, window, content hash) live in the sidecar manifest, daily_panel_manifest.schema.json. ONE DEFINITION of keys, columns and the parity comparator: contracts/daily_panel.py. PRODUCER TEST: tests/test_daily_panel_contract.py. Consumer: crucible (v2 data.daily), pinned at crucible:tests/contracts/daily_panel.schema.json (contracts/daily_panel.py::CONSUMER).

trading_day.description: The NYSE session this bar belongs to (YYYY-MM-DD). Stored in the parquet as a date; rendered ISO for validation.

ticker.description: ArcticDB `universe` symbol key, exactly as the library stores it (no renaming).
